title: Graduate civil engineer or civil draftsperson - expression of interest (Melbourne)
content_text: Breese Pitt Dixon careers page (verified 2026-10-03): For more than 40 years BPD has helped shape Melbourne land development through civil engineering, surveying and planning. Civil engineers design major estates and infrastructure such as wetlands, retarding basins, trunk sewers, drainage and roads, and manage delivery through tendering and contract management. Who they are looking for includes graduate and experienced civil engineers, and Survey Assistants, Technicians, Draftspersons. They do not advertise individual vacancies on the careers page. Email an introduction with CV and a short note on the kind of work sought to info@bpd.com.au. Office: 1/19 Cato Street Hawthorn East VIC 3123. Phone +61 3 8823 2300.
apply_instructions: Email expression of interest with CV and short note to info@bpd.com.au as published on https://www.bpd.com.au/careers
